scene black
It was just like any other Friday...
scene dormwarsfiveintro1
Except it wasn’t because it was time for the Dorm Wars!
: Ladies and gentlemen!
: And also Molly!
: Are you going to do this every time?!
: Tradition is tradition! You are loved and respected. And also necessary for at least two competitions this year!
: I...will take it!
: And I will continue with my introduction since I am basically just the queen of the Dorm Wars now!
scene dormwarsfiveintro2
: Now — the title we’ve gone with this time is Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars - Heaven & Hell (And Heckin’ Hot Girls)!
: But you didn’t hear that subtitle from me and I am only just now finding out that it was added.
: We needed more H’s.
: I am also surprised to suddenly find out it was Makoto who added it and not Uta, who is openly attracted to at least half of the class.
: Correction! It’s not open, so you’ll never guess who and live in a permanent state of wondering if you’re in the 50%%!
: Am-
: Nope!
: Hah...
: Don’t worry, Kirin. One day, someone other than me will appreciate your beauty.
: Can I continue or do y’all just wanna make out with each other for the rest of the day?
: Makoto?
: Is that an invitation to kiss you or are you asking for me to weigh in on something Miss Imai has clear authority on?
: It’s one of those things, yes.
: Aight, I’m just gonna go for it.
scene dormwarsfiveintro3
: Now, you may be wondering why we’ve decided to call this year’s Dorm Wars “Heaven & Hell.” And no, the answer has nothing to do with Yasu.
: It does, however, have something to do with the way the competition will be split up this year.
: The first day will be “Heaven.” And we’ll have a bunch of lighthearted and fun stuff, some old and some new, that most of the class will be participating in.
: The second day is one that Uta has been pressuring me into for an entire year now because “supervision hampers creativity and competition” or something like that.
: Imani also couldn’t bring herself to be around for the resurrection of the Date War. You’re welcome, class!
: Just as an FYI though, this doesn’t mean day two will be complete and utter chaos as I’ll still be filling in for Miss Imai as “supervisor.”
: There will, however, be several competitions that we will run on our own without her help — similar to the way things were during the first Dorm Wars.
scene dormwarsfiveintro4
: It’s all with Imani’s blessing, though! And shouldn’t be misinterpreted as us not wanting to be around her since last year’s competition was some of the most fun we’ve ever had!
: Unless your name is Ami or Maya and you threw the entire first floor’s case into jeopardy in pursuit of personal gain.
: Less guilt tripping, more praise. It’s not often you get a teacher who has so much faith in you that she lets you spend your weekend alone.
: It probably should be.
scene dormwarsfiveintro5
: Anyway, Sensei will be coming back to participate this year. But, and sorry to break your hearts, he’ll also be abstaining from day two. Right, Makoto?
: Why yes. That is absolutely correct.
: We don’t want him there anyway. Day two is for girls only. A boy would just ruin everything.
: Any questions before we get to the contest announcements? From people not named Kirin who aren’t going to ask me to bone them?
: I have one. Is there actually going to be a prize this year or are we just doing this for bragging rights again?
: I don’t know. We’ll figure that out later. That’s all the time we have for questions, though!
: That was hardly five parsecs!
: Parsecs are a measurement of distance! How many times must I explain this to you?!
scene dormwarsfiveintro6
: Makoto, why don’t you go ahead and-
: Way ahead of you, Miss Imai. One last note before we begin, though. Uta?
: You may find that some of this year’s match-ups involve competitors who we imagine would struggle at them.
: Which is why the first contest we will announce is another trivia game. This time between Miku and Yasu.
scene dormwarsfiveintro7
: Please tell me it’s sports trivia.
: It’s not.
: My life is over.
: We’ll get through this together, Miku. Even if we’re on opposite teams.
: Rough start. At this rate, Kirin’s going to get forced into an abstinence contest.
: Close! Kirin’s competing in a one-on-one D&D match against Chika!
scene dormwarsfiveintro8
: That’s the same exact thing! Just somehow even worse!
: Objection! The Dungeons and Dragons community has just as much intercourse as any other! Probably more! And just because you don’t understand-
: Sorry, Molly! Don’t speak virgin! Can’t understand you!
: Maaaan! I want that one! Onee-chan and I used to 1v1 all the time since we couldn’t find anyone else to play with us.
: Let’s hope Noriko doesn’t wind up in a blowjob contest since saying things like that makes her actively less likely to ever get laid!
scene dormwarsfiveintro9
: I’d be great at that. No gag reflex, remember?
: I don’t believe you. We will need to have our own contest so you can prove it to me.
: Ahem! There will be no sexual competitions since you are all in high school.
: Also Kirin, you have detention for calling nerds virgins. There are a lot of nerds in this class. You are severely outnumbered.
scene dormwarsfiveintro10
: Ugh. My only saving grace is that I’m going up against Chika.
: At least you have a saving grace. I don’t know anything about literally anything. It’s all just wieners and balls now. Both kinds of balls. I am doomed.
: What’s my contest, guys? Do I get the Date War again? Please tell me I get the Date War again.
: We just put you in a cooking competition against Yumi since you’re good at everything and everyone else is afraid of her.
scene dormwarsfiveintro11
: Yay! More quality time with my best friend! I can’t wait to tell her when she finally shows up to class!
: Hey! I’m supposed to be your best friend!
scene dormwarsfiveintro12
: Rin, will you help me learn D&D so I can wipe the floor with Kirin so bad that we’ll be cleaning her blood off of it for the next year?
: You mean like what we already did with Nodoka’s after Yumi beat the crap out of her?
: Yeah, just worse.
: Sure, I can teach you. Just don’t let it negatively impact your view of me since I may or may not have attempted to shield you from the fact that I know how to play at all.
: But I like you being a nerd. It’s cute.
: I can’t wait to show you my dice.
: Is it just me or do those two flirt a lot now?
: It’s definitely not just you. Don’t worry.
: Let’s see, let’s see...oh! Moving right along, our next contest is another one we’ve done before!
: And one that will hopefully not be nearly as awkward or uncomfortable as the last time we did it based on who we’ve chosen to compete this time around.
: You know it! You love it! Stand-up comedy is back! And this time, it’s a battle between our most buxom beauties, Futaba Fukuyama and Touka Tsukioka!
scene dormwarsfiveintro13
: Wait! S...Stand-up?! Comedy?! You...expect me to...go on stage and...be funny?!
: No! That’s exactly why we picked you.
: This is perhaps the most cruel thing anyone has done to me yet.
: Don’t worry, Futaba! We’ll all be right there cheering you on!
scene dormwarsfiveintro14
: That’s exactly the problem!
: Futaba’s had stage fright for as long as I’ve known her. She’s also chronically unfunny.
: Oh.
: Thanks, Rin! I really appreciate that! I can definitely do my best now!
: Conventionally unfunny! I think you’re perfect in every way. But the world disagrees. All of it. And they are probably right because they’re not biased like me.
: Again! Thank you!
: Heh...
: Finally something that caters to my strengths.
: You think you can do it, Touka? You won’t get nervous?
scene dormwarsfiveintro15
: Nervous? Please. I’ve had eyes on me since the moment I was born. Which doesn’t even touch upon the fact that I’ve been taking rakugo lessons since I was a child.
: Rakugo?
scene dormwarsfiveintro16
: Did someone call for a weebnote?!
: Rakugo, meaning “fallen words,” is a traditional form of Japanese verbal comedy dating all the way back to the 18th century! It’s not something just anyone can do either!
: Rakugo employs a strict tier structure where one must work their way up from apprenticeship under the tutelage of someone who has already done that!
: And while it’s this exact formula and cycle that adds to the beauty of the craft, it’s also the primary contributor to the unfortunate fact that it’s a dying art!
: That said, there are still around 300-400 routines that are performed regularly to this day and-
: Okay, I get it now.
scene dormwarsfiveintro15
: Then my job here is done!
: Touka, as impressive and unsurprising as your apparent rakugo training is, I don’t think that’s what the girls are looking for and I can’t imagine you grabbing a W with it.
scene dormwarsfiveintro17
: I did not intend to.
: What you will receive instead is a surprisingly modern stand-up comedy routine that even the shockingly handsome American movie star, Seth Rogen, would envy.
: Did I...Sorry, did I just hear that right?
: You sure did, Imani. You sure did.
: That’s amazing, Touka! I wish I could be as well-versed in entertaining people as you! All I can do is scare them!
scene dormwarsfiveintro18
: That’s not true, Yasu! Cheer is a form of entertainment and you were quite exceptional at that during last year’s event!
: Y-A-S-U! Guess who is my favorite?! You!
scene dormwarsfiveintro19
: My, you’re becoming cuter by the day! I find it so hard to believe you used to sleep in an alley.
: Otoha — would you hug me?
scene dormwarsfiveintro20
: Sorry, what?
: Hug me. Would you do it?
: Is there...context to this? Or...
: Does there need to be?
: Nodoka, are you dying?
scene dormwarsfiveintro21
: Not that I’m aware of. I’m just curious. That’s all.
: Uhhh...
: Well, if you’re talking about right now, no.
scene dormwarsfiveintro22
: Why?
: Because we’re in the middle of class. Context is important when it comes to physicality and...stuff like that.
: But if the conditions were right, you would hug me?
: I...guess? Are you seriously okay? Is something going on or-
: Just to clarify, this isn’t a sexual thing. I’m talking about a platonic hug. The kind that friends share with one another.
: That...is also what I was talking about.
: Okay. I just wanted to be sure.
: Uhhhh...okay.
scene dormwarsfiveintro23
: That’s all. Thank you.
: The fuck, yo?
: Now, Makoto — to celebrate Sensei coming back into the picture and definitely not being around for day two, it wouldn’t feel right to just ignore him, right?
: Uhhh...hold on. I can’t remember where I put my index card- ah! Here. Ahem.
: Why yes, Uta. And considering that the date war takes place on day two, there just had to be something we could do for him. Which is why-
: My line. Which is why we’ve decided to include a brand new contest all about being as nice to him as you possibly can!
scene dormwarsfiveintro24
: They’re going to give this one to me, aren’t they?
: And who better to compete than Maya Makinami and Otoha Okakura?
: Another year, another loss.
: At least I get to compete against Maya, though.
scene dormwarsfiveintro25
: Going in with any battle plan, Maya? Or are you just gonna fuck him?
: I don’t think that’s allowed.
: Damn, Ami. Is subtlety just not even a thing for you anymore or what?
: I’m just thinking of how to win and taking all of Maya’s strengths into consideration. And I don’t think she knows how to be nice to Sensei without fucking him.
scene dormwarsfiveintro26
: She’s not wrong.
: Of course she’s wrong! I’ve seen you be nice to Sensei plenty of times! And I highly suggest you don’t do what Ami said because this is a day one contest!
: So if it was day two-
: Let’s just all fuck him together. As best friends.
if amifingered == False:
: It might be the only chance I ever have.
scene dormwarsfiveintro27
: So can I inquire about why you two are touching me? Or-
: Because we love you. And Ami, stop being weird. Just because...certain information has come to light, doesn’t make it so everything must now revolve around-
: I’m not talking about everything, Ayane. I just seriously want to win. And if we need to cheat, I say we do it.
scene dormwarsfiveintro28
: Why do you want to win so badly? There isn’t even a prize yet.
: Key word — yet. But if there is, it’ll obviously involve my dad. And if letting my friends fuck my dad gets me closer to my dad, I’m willing to take the hit.
scene dormwarsfiveintro29
: I have no clue who or what you are anymore, so I can’t figure out why this somehow still surprises me.
: Ami, while I understand that your life may suddenly be very confusing and...you may feel...betrayed about certain actions your friends have taken-
: I’m over it. New hair, new me. Scorned Ami has arrived and is ready to win the Dorm Wars by any means necessary.
scene dormwarsfiveintro30
: R...Regardless! I think Maya can easily win without doing something like that. Which is why I think she should just be normally nice to Sensei.
: Not gonna lie, I like Ami’s idea a little better.
: Of course you do, slut.
scene dormwarsfiveintro31
: I like it less when you put it like that.
: Sorry. Slip of the tongue.
: Hah...I miss our old dynamic.
scene dormwarsfiveintro32
: With only two contests remaining on day one, why don’t we break out the most exciting news yet, Makoto?!
: Because we could get into legal trouble for endangering the lives of everyone in class.
: THEN LET’S FRIGGIN’ ENDANGER ‘EM! DEATH BALL’S MAKIN’ A COMEBACK, BABY!
scene dormwarsfiveintro33
: Oh no.
: What the hell is “Death Ball?”
: I don’t know, but I feel like I’d be really good at it.
: We played it last year while you two were...away. It was, uhh...
: It was big.
: My time has come once more.
: Unfortunately, Tsunecchi, no it hasn’t. Your contest is on day two. We figured letting you play would be an unfair advantage after last year.
: But hey! Your roommate gets to this time! And there might actually be a little less chaos since she’ll be going up against Ami in a slightly downscaled version of the game!
: How can one downscale that which is large enough to consume the world?
: Yay! Are we talking about God now?
: In a sense, I think we are.
: Uta, can I ask how exactly one plays “Death Ball?”
: Yes! You can. But there is no answer.
: And that’s because Death Ball plays you. Paramedics will be on premises this time. And there will be no documentary crew allowed.
: Documentary crew?
: Yeah. You two missed an entire timeskip.
: Woah, crazy. No idea how I’d handle one of those.
scene dormwarsfiveintro34
: What?
: What?
: You just...
: That sounded a little sarcastic...is all.
: Mmm...I don’t think so. You didn’t hear any sarcasm there, right Maya?
: She sounded normal to me.
: ...Okay.
: Sure.
scene dormwarsfiveintro35
: Our final day one competition announcement is another brand new battle! One of wits and perseverance!
: And one I’m surprised you agreed to given that you seem slightly handicapped on an...intellectual level.
: Are you calling me dumb, Makoto?
: Not dumb per se. Just not nearly as smart as I am.
scene dormwarsfiveintro36
: Then it appears we will have to put that to the test in a brand new, courtroom style battle between prosecutor Makoto and defense attorney Uta!
: Your funeral, I guess.
scene dormwarsfiveintro37
: But yeah — Uta and I will be battling it out in a case that a jury of our peers, you guys, will need to decide how to rule on.
: If Makoto gets my client convicted, she wins. But if the glove does not fit, I win!
: And while we can’t make you vote against your own floor if you’re just trying to win points-
: We urge you not to so we can keep this as fair and even as possible!
: Cool, yeah! Now bring on the stuff we get to do behind Imani’s back!
: Yeah! We all want to know who’s in the date war this year!
: There are only three pairs left, aren’t there? Which means, from the first floor, it’s either Sana, Ayane, or-
: The date war will be fought between Rin and Io.
: But remember, it totally will not be with Sensei since he won’t be there.
: Oh God...
scene dormwarsfiveintro38
: Question — how does this work exactly? Because I have never paid attention to any of this before and I am suddenly very interested.
: Basically Io, you just come up with a date idea and spend the morning or afternoon having fun based on whichever time slot you agree upon!
: And the person we are going on that date with is the one who chooses the winner? There’s no point system or anything like that?
: That is correct, yes.
: Come to think of it, who is the date with exactly? Because I still haven’t heard-
: Me. I’m the date.
: And am I supposed to choose what you like or-
: If that’s what you want, sure!
: Or you can be cool and independent like me and show Uta a piece of your world, Io! I’m sure she’d love-
: Don’t talk to me. I’m thinking.
: Guh. Another difficult target. She’s my next target after Yumi.
: Good luck. I’ve been trying since she transferred in and I feel like she hates me even more now.
: One more question. Sorry. Is this really okay?
: Is what okay? The date war is practically a tradition at this point. Even if it was briefly outlawed along with our final competition.
: Just...you know...letting me do this when I am the least interested in Dorm Wars out of everyone.
: We wanted you to cooperate, Io. And hey! Maybe this will show you the Dorm Wars can be fun?!
: Thank you...I...appreciate this.
scene dormwarsfiveintro39
: Of course! That said, only two contests remain now, girls! And one of them is an all time classic — the gothic lolita fashion show!
: Lolita part optional this time as there seemed to be some confusion regarding the first floor girls’ entry the last time we did this.
: We worked with what we had! It was hard! Not everyone can be Molly!
: Well let’s hope it’s less hard this time as you’ll be competing, Ayane! Against our very own CEO and self-proclaimed incest girl, Nodoka Nagasawa!
: Nodoka? You in there? You hear that?
: I wonder if Akira would hug me.
: Okay. I’ll just let you find out on your own.
: Yumi! You’re here! Guess what! We’re-
: Not in the mood. Couldn’t get to sleep last-
scene dormwarsfiveintro40
: Bro.
: Present.
: The fuck are you wearing?
: I forgot which special event we were holding today. We have too many of them.
: But a pleasant mistake it was as the world can now feast its eyes upon another MacCormack creation!
: So are you tryin’ to blind everybody or what?
scene dormwarsfiveintro41
: Okay! So you should have all figured out by process of elimination now that the final pair of contestants consists of Sana and Tsuneyo!
: But we still haven’t revealed what they’re competing in! Just that it was something else we outlawed!
: Something that Imani specifically outlawed. But seeing as she and no one else is going to be present for it, we can do it again.
: Though I kind of wish we wouldn’t since I cannot possibly understand how we will win this.
: The swimsuit contest is back! And it’s sexy vs sweet this time as the tallest, most bodacious girl in class takes on...Sana. Who is Sana.
: Who...may just surprise us for reasons I can not explain. But I still imagine it will be an uphill battle.
: So I have to...show off my body in...in front of everyone?...
scene dormwarsfiveintro42
: We can be exhibitionists together, Zagull Throat-
: Tsuneyo.
scene dormwarsfiveintro43
: Who is Zagull Throat-Tsuneyo? I know not of this person, nor the reason they bear my name.
: You know I need to ask you to take that off, right?
: In front of everyone? Do you doubt my exhibitionism, bro?
: No, I mean you aren’t allowed to wear that to school. We can’t get away with it like we can on Halloween.
: I’m sorry. Is being beautiful a crime now?
: No, but indecent exposure is.
: Miss Imai, can’t you at least let her wear it until lunch? It’s quite difficult for the Kendo Princess to just slip out of-
scene black
: Wait, already?! How long have we been preparing for battle?!
: You were saying, Molly?
: That...uhh...
: Fine. I will strip for you, Miss Imai. But only because you asked.
: Whaaaa, no! I did not ask you to strip! Nor will I further comment on- why are you coming closer to me?!
: Because it’s what you want. I understand when I am desired. Just know that I find this very inappropriate.
: Just...aah! Class dismissed! Everyone go eat! Maya last, though! I keep getting complaints about her!
: Why am I so universally hated?...
